sentences.l2: 打哈欠看起来很简单，但它的背后有很多科学原因。
sentences.l1: Yawning looks very simple, but there are many scientific reasons behind it.

sentences.l2: 生物学研究发现，很多动物都会打哈欠，不只是人类。
sentences.l1: Biological research has found that many animals yawn, not only humans.

sentences.l2: 这说明打哈欠可能是一种很古老的生理功能。
sentences.l1: This suggests that yawning may be a very ancient physiological function.

sentences.l2: 有些人早上起床时打哈欠，有些人感到无聊时也会打。
sentences.l1: Some people yawn when they get up in the morning, and some people also yawn when they feel bored.

sentences.l2: 科学家认为，这可能和大脑的工作状态有关。
sentences.l1: Scientists think that this may be related to the working state of the brain.

sentences.l2: 神经学的研究显示，打哈欠和大脑中的某些神经信号有关。
sentences.l1: Neurological research shows that yawning is related to certain neural signals in the brain.

sentences.l2: 当我们疲劳或注意力下降时，大脑会发出信号，引发打哈欠的动作。
sentences.l1: When we are tired or our attention drops, the brain sends out signals that trigger the action of yawning.

sentences.l2: 这个动作可以帮助我们短暂地提高警觉。
sentences.l1: This action can help us raise our alertness for a short time.

sentences.l2: 有一种理论认为，打哈欠能帮助调节大脑温度。
sentences.l1: One theory holds that yawning can help regulate brain temperature.

sentences.l2: 当大脑太热时，打哈欠可以让凉爽的空气进入体内，帮助大脑降温，让它更好地工作。
sentences.l1: When the brain is too hot, yawning can let cool air enter the body, helping the brain cool down and making it work better.

sentences.l2: 还有一个有趣的现象是打哈欠的传染性。
sentences.l1: Another interesting phenomenon is the contagiousness of yawning.

sentences.l2: 当你看到别人打哈欠，你可能很快也会跟着打。
sentences.l1: When you see others yawn, you may soon yawn along too.

sentences.l2: 这并不是因为困，而可能和大脑中的“镜像神经元”有关。
sentences.l1: This is not because of being sleepy, but may be related to "mirror neurons" in the brain.

sentences.l2: 这些神经元会在我们模仿他人行为时被激活。
sentences.l1: These neurons are activated when we imitate other people's behavior.

sentences.l2: 心理学家发现，人和人之间关系越亲近，越容易互相传染打哈欠。
sentences.l1: Psychologists have found that the closer the relationship between people, the more easily they pass yawns to each other.

sentences.l2: 虽然打哈欠很常见，但它的完整功能还没有完全被科学家理解。
sentences.l1: Although yawning is very common, its complete function has still not been fully understood by scientists.

sentences.l2: 有的研究说它帮助清醒，有的说它帮助放松。
sentences.l1: Some studies say it helps one wake up, and some say it helps one relax.

sentences.l2: 但可以肯定的是，打哈欠不只是一种习惯，而是身体自然调节的一部分。
sentences.l1: But what can be certain is that yawning is not just a habit, but part of the body's natural regulation.

sentences.l2: 未来的研究可能会发现更多关于它的秘密。
sentences.l1: Future research may discover more secrets about it.
